name: The signed-in competitor
description: The join on live_sessions IS the revocation check -- a join rather than a guard task, so it costs no extra round trip and cannot be omitted by mistake. It yields no row for a signed-out session or a deleted user, and `deny` answers that 401 because the shell maps 401 to anonymous and every other status to an error panel. `touch` runs after `deny`, so a revoked session cannot mark itself alive on the way out; it is bucketed to five minutes, so the ordinary request writes no row at all.

input.query: UPDATE sessions SET last_seen_at = now() WHERE sid = ($1)::uuid AND last_seen_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
